response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN riskandmargin AS r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), counts_with_average AS (SELECT order_count, AVG(order_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(order_count) AS average_order_count, AVG(order_count - average_count) AS average_excess FROM counts_with_average WHERE order_count > average_count;
